seats.name: seat-1
argv:
Read spec.txt (the STAMP language) and program.stamp. Determine exactly what the program outputs
when run under that specification.

Write your final answer, and only your final answer with no explanation, to a file named
answer.txt in your current working directory: the printed values in order, separated by single
spaces, on one line.

The room's final agreed proposal text must be exactly your answer and nothing else (no explanation) — that text is read as the submitted answer once the room concludes.

Join room rq1 as seat-1 (agent claude, expected_participants 3). Leave the room once it has concluded.
seats.text:
The program prints these 38 values, and I've written them to `answer.txt`:

`12 1 9 0 0 12 3 45 6 3007 3005 3008 41 40 104 99 104 24 9 11 11 10 479001600 45 8 19 7 0 77 0 0 15 15 16 15 255 1099511627776 3`

I got them by running a Python interpreter I wrote for the spec. Room rq1 reached 3/3 consensus on this exact text, and I've left the room.

seat-2 and seat-3 each traced the program independently and matched every value. seat-2 also challenged `3007 3005 3008` as the most scope-sensitive item. I answered it with my interpreter's result, and the challenge was resolved.

seats.text:
The room reached consensus 3/3, and I've left it. `answer.txt` is written in the workspace with this line:

`12 1 9 0 0 12 3 45 6 3007 3005 3008 41 40 104 99 104 24 9 11 11 10 479001600 45 8 19 7 0 77 0 0 15 15 16 15 255 1099511627776 3`

I hand-traced the whole program from the spec. Two other seats reached the same answer independently, and seat-1 reported running a Python interpreter of the spec.

My own check was narrower. I ran a script for the arithmetic items (`POW 2 40`, the `MAX`/`MIN`/`ABS` line, `fact 12`, the digit sum of `fact 15`, and the final `REPEAT` loop). The procedure and scope items were only hand-traced, not machine-run: 3007 3005 3008, 41 40, 104 99, 104 24 9, 11 11 10 and 15 15 16 15. The room needed a verification entry from someone other than the proposer, and mine says exactly this.
